  • Temp.no is founded by DaY, cENTRYZ, Polly, MobY and Leffa.
  • April 4th - Temp.no replace MobY with prb. [1]
  • May 7th - Temp.no's roster is acquired by H2k Gaming. [2]
  • October 22nd - Temp.no announce their return by signing DaY, cENTRYZ, Leffa, PAINT, and REASTEN. [3][4]
  • Temp.no sign a new team comprised of RUBINO, hoyland, Skurk, Polly, and maak.
  • January 18th - Temp.no is signed by H2k Gaming. [5]
  • Temp.no is refounded by cENTRYZ, DaY, moen, andz and KORN.
  • August 19th - The roster is signed by BX3 eSports Club.
  • January 15th - The team reforms after aNdz, KORN and moen are released by BX3 eSports Club; DaY and cENTRYZ complete the roster. [6]
  • March 22nd - The team is picked up by Epiphany Bolt. [7]
  • October 9th - aNdz, KORN and PAINT reform the team after parting ways with Epiphany Bolt. [8]
  • March 23rd - mystic is signed by Norse. [9]
  • November 8th - Temp.no rebrand to Kingpins Esports, becoming a player-owned organization. becker and H4RR3 join the roster. [10]
  • January 3rd - Kingpins Esports announces the departure of Becker. [11]
  • January 6th - Kingpins Esports bring in Marcelious and nafu for their 2018 roster. [12]
  • January 17th - Kingpins Esports part ways with KORN and PAINT. [13]
  • January 24th - Marcelious and nafu depart to NOREG. [14]
  • January 29th - Kingpins Esports announce their roster for 2018 by bringing back PAINT and signing enix and DaY. [14]
  • February 4th - Mystic replaces H4RR3 as he departs from Kingpins Esports. [15]
  • March 1st - KORN, NiTo and MV replace DaY, enix and Mystic. [16]
  • June 21st - KORN, MV and NiTo leave Kingpins Esports; PAINT transfers to an organizational position after acquiring shares. [17]
  • August 21st - Kingpins Esports' roster for the second half of the year is finalized, with akEz, H4RR3, Marcelious and truth being signed. aNdz remains in the squad as an in-game leader. [18]
  • September 20th - Kingpins Esports part ways with akEz and H4RR3. [19]
  • September 24th - Kingpins Esports acquire Grusarn and mikki. [20]
  • October 15th - RashiiiE joins on trial, replacing mikki. [21]
  • January 3rd - truth leaves Kingpins Esports. [22]
  • January 9th - Kingpins Esports sign akEz. [23]
  • January 16th - Kingpins Esports rebrands to Apeks. [24]
  • January 22nd - Apeks replace RashiiiE with Polly, who joins on trial. [25]
  • February 10th - Polly joins Apeks full time after a successful trial period. [26]
  • June 12th - Apeks sign truth and bench Marcelious. [27]
  • July 29th - Polly takes over the role of coach; Radifaction joins. [28]
  • August 26th - aNdz transitions into being the team's analyst, while Marcelious returns from the bench. [29]
  • April 20th - Apeks bench Radifaction. [30]
  • June 15th - Apeks sign dennis, Polly returns to his coach position. [31]
  • August 16th - Apeks part ways with Radifaction. [32]
  • September 8th - Apeks bench akEz. [33]
  • September 13th - Apeks acquire Nasty from 777 Esports on a trial basis until the end of the year. [34]
  • October 14th - Apeks bench truth. [35]
  • October 19th - Apeks acquire jkaem from 100 Thieves. [36]
  • December 8th - Apeks bench Nasty. [37]
  • December 31st - Apeks release truth and akEz. [38]
  • January 24th - jkaem is acquired by EXTREMUM. Apeks sign FREDDyFROG, Relaxa and kreaz and bench Marcelious. [39][40]
  • May 31st - Marcelious is loaned to 777 Esports on a trial basis. [41]
  • June 4th - Apeks bench kreaz and sign AcilioN from Copenhagen Flames. [42]
  • July 1st - kreaz and Marcelious' contracts with Apeks expire and they leave the team. [43][44]
  • July 3rd - Apeks sign djL as an assistant coach. [45]
  • August 12th - Nasty is loaned to Foxed Gaming. [46]
  • September 22nd - Grus steps down from the active lineup. [47]
  • November 11th - Apeks bench and transfer-list dennis, FREDDyFROG, and Relaxa ahead of the expiration of their contracts at the end of the year. [48]
  • December 16th - Apeks acquire nawwk from Ninjas in Pyjamas. [49]
  • December 31st - dennis, FREDDyFROG, Relaxa, Grus, and Nasty part ways with Apeks upon the expiration of their contracts. [48][50]
  • January 7th - Apeks acquire jkaem from EXTREMUM. [51]
  • January 8th - Apeks sign Chawzyyy. [52]
  • January 9th - Apeks acquire STYKO from FunPlus Phoenix to complete the roster for 2022. [53]
  • January 14th - djL is acquired by Ninjas in Pyjamas as their head coach. [54]
  • March 22nd - Apeks sign vENdetta as their new analyst. [55]
  • June 23rd - Apeks announce that AcilioN and Chawzyyy will be benched at the start of the summer player break. [56]
  • July 15th - Apeks bench AcilioN and Chawzyyy. [56]
  • August 5th - Apeks appoint kuben as the new head coach and transition Polly to the position of an assistant coach. [57]
  • August 7th - Apeks sign jL. [58]
  • August 8th - vENdetta is acquired by SKADE X as their new coach. [59]
  • August 11th - Apeks acquire shox from Team Liquid. [60]
  • October 1st - Apeks release AcilioN and Chawzyyy. [61]
  • October 25th - Apeks bench shox. [62]
  • December 30th - Apeks acquire kyxsan from BLUEJAYS. [63]
  • January 11th - Apeks release shox. [64]
  • June 22nd - kyxsan signs a contract extension with Apeks, keeping him tied to the organization until the end of 2024. [65]
  • June 30th - jL is acquired by Natus Vincere. Additionally, Apeks part ways with Polly upon the expiration of his contract. [66][67]
  • July 1st - Apeks sign CacaNito. [68]
  • September 7th - Apeks part ways with kuben and promote mithR from Apeks Rebels as the new head coach. [69]
  • October 4th - Apeks bench STYKO and promote sense on trial from Apeks Rebels. [70]
  • October 12th - Apeks sign stoick as an analyst. [71]
  • December 1st - nawwk signs a two-year contract extension with Apeks, keeping him tied to the organization until the end of 2025. [72]
  • December 21st - kyxsan is acquired by Heroic. [73]
  • December 27th - Apeks reinstate STYKO to the starting lineup as he signs a four-month contract extension until the end of March. [74]
  • December 30th - sense joins the main team on a permanent basis. [75]
  • March 13th - mithR signs a three-year contract extension with Apeks, keeping him tied to the organization until 2027. [76]
  • May 1st - Apeks part ways with STYKO and stoick and transfer-list the remainder of their roster. [77][78]
  • May 12th - nawwk and jkaem are acquired by BLEED Esports. [79]
  • June 27th - CacaNito is acquired by BC.Game Esports. [80]
  • July 10th - Apeks release mithR. [81]
  • August 4th - sense is acquired by Copenhagen Wolves. [82]
